00134              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00135              MOVE M-COUNT TO PELLETS-LEFT.
00136          RESET-GHOST.
00137              MOVE GS-X (WS-G) TO GH-X (WS-G).
00138              MOVE GS-Y (WS-G) TO GH-Y (WS-G).

00141              MOVE GH-X (WS-G) TO M-X.
00142              MOVE GH-Y (WS-G) TO M-Y.
00143              MOVE 'CLR ' TO M-OP.
00144              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00145          DO-QUIT.
00146              MOVE 1 TO F-QUIT.
00147              MOVE 'QUIT   ' TO GAME-STATE.
00148          DO-MOVE.
00149              MOVE REQ-CHAR TO LAST-CMD.
00150              MOVE PLAYER-X TO NEW-X.
00151              MOVE PLAYER-Y TO NEW-Y.
00152              MOVE 'MOVED  ' TO LAST-RESULT.
00153              PERFORM AIM-MOVE THRU AIM-MOVE-EXIT.
00154              ADD 1 TO TICK-COUNT.
00155              MOVE NEW-X TO M-X.
00156              MOVE NEW-Y TO M-Y.
00157              MOVE 'WALL' TO M-OP.
00158              CALL 'PACMAP' USING PAC-STATE MAP-REQ.
00159              IF M-FLAG = 1
00160                  MOVE 'BLOCKED' TO LAST-RESULT
00161              ELSE

00163                  MOVE NEW-Y TO PLAYER-Y

00165              PERFORM ROUND-END THRU ROUND-END-EXIT.

00169                  SUBTRACT 1 FROM NEW-Y
00170              ELSE IF REQ-DIR = 'D'

00174              ELSE IF REQ-DIR = 'R'

00186              IF PELLETS-LEFT = 0

00188          EAT-PELLET-EXIT.
00189              EXIT.
00190          ROUND-END.
00191              MOVE 0 TO F-HIT.
00192              PERFORM CHECK-HIT THRU CHECK-HIT-EXIT.
00193              IF F-HIT = 0 AND F-WON = 0 AND AI-LEVEL > 0

00195                  PERFORM CHECK-HIT THRU CHECK-HIT-EXIT.
00196              IF F-HIT = 1
00197                  PERFORM LOSE-LIFE THRU LOSE-LIFE-EXIT.
00198          ROUND-END-EXIT.
00199              EXIT.

00203          CHECK-HIT-EXIT.
00204              EXIT.

00206              IF GH-X (WS-G) = PLAYER-X AND GH-Y (WS-G) = PLAYER-Y

00208          HIT-TEST-EXIT.

00211              MOVE 0 TO F-WON.

00213              IF LIVES = 0
00214                  MOVE 1 TO F-LOST
00215                  MOVE 'LOST   ' TO LAST-RESULT
00216              ELSE
00217                  MOVE 'DIED   ' TO LAST-RESULT
00218                  MOVE 2 TO PLAYER-X
00219                  MOVE 2 TO PLAYER-Y
00220                  PERFORM RESET-GHOST VARYING WS-G FROM 1 BY 1
00221                      UNTIL WS-G > GHOST-COUNT
00222                  IF PELLETS-LEFT = 0
00223                      MOVE 1 TO F-WON.
00224          LOSE-LIFE-EXIT.
00225              EXIT.   5


00226          SET-STATE.
00227              IF F-LOST = 1
00228                  MOVE 'LOST   ' TO GAME-STATE
00229              ELSE IF F-WON = 1
00230                  MOVE 'WON    ' TO GAME-STATE
00231              ELSE
00232                  MOVE 'RUNNING' TO GAME-STATE.
00233          SET-STATE-EXIT.

00393          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAC-STATE PAC-REQ PAC-DS.
00394          MAIN-PARA.
00395              IF TAB-OK = 0
00396                  PERFORM INIT-TAB.   8


00397              IF SC-INIT = 0
00398                  PERFORM INIT-SCALE.
00399              MOVE 0 TO DS-OVF.
00400              IF REQ-OP = 'INVL'
00401                  MOVE 1 TO MSG-ON
00402                  MOVE REQ-CHAR TO INV-CHAR
00403              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'PRMT'
00404                  PERFORM DO-PRMT THRU DO-PRMT-EXIT
00405              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'TICK'
00406                  PERFORM DO-TICK THRU DO-TICK-EXIT
00407              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'FULL'
00408                  PERFORM DO-FULL THRU DO-FULL-EXIT
00409              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'ENDS'
00410                  PERFORM DO-ENDS THRU DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00411              GOBACK.
00412          DO-PRMT.
00413              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00414              MOVE 'F' TO DS-KIND.
00415              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00416              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y'
00417                  PERFORM TOGGLE-VIS.
00418              PERFORM SET-FACE.
00419              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00420              PERFORM PRMT-BODY.
00421         * MVS-GS SIZE GUARD: A SCALED SCREEN THAT DID NOT FIT IS REPLACED
00422         * BY THE G4 SCREEN (SCALING OFF FOR THE REST OF THE GAME).
00423              IF DS-OVF = 1
00424                  PERFORM SCALE-OFF
00425                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS
00426                  PERFORM PRMT-BODY.
00427              MOVE MSG-ON TO MSG-LAST.
00428              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00429          DO-PRMT-EXIT.
00430              EXIT.
00431          PRMT-BODY.
00432              IF REQ-REDRAW = 'P'
00433                  PERFORM PRMT-VS
00434              ELSE
00435                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00436              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00437          PRMT-VS.
00438         * VIRTUAL IMAGE FIRST; FULL SCREEN WHEN THE TERMINAL HAS NOTHING
00439         * KNOWN (FIRST SCREEN) OR THE LAST INPUT WAS A REDRAW REQUEST.
00440              PERFORM BUILD-VS.
00441              IF PREV-OK = 1 AND REQ-KIND NOT = 'RDR'
00442                  PERFORM BUILD-PARTIAL.
00443              IF PREV-OK = 0 OR REQ-KIND = 'RDR'
00444                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00445              PERFORM KEEP-VS.
00446          DO-FULL.
00447              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00448              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00449              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00450              MOVE MSG-LAST TO MSG-ON.
00451              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00452              IF DS-OVF = 1
00453                  PERFORM SCALE-OFF   9


00454                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS
00455                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00456              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00457              MOVE 0 TO PREV-OK.
00458          DO-FULL-EXIT.
00459              EXIT.
00460          DO-TICK.
00461              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00462              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND REQ-REDRAW = 'P' AND PREV-OK = 1
00463                                AND SC-ON = 1
00464                  PERFORM TICK-BUILD-S
00465              ELSE IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND REQ-REDRAW = 'P'
00466                                AND PREV-OK = 1
00467                  PERFORM TICK-BUILD.
00468         * A TICK THAT DID NOT FIT: G4 FULL SCREEN INSTEAD (DS-KIND F).
00469              IF DS-OVF = 1
00470                  PERFORM SCALE-OFF
00471                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS
00472                  MOVE MSG-LAST TO MSG-ON
00473                  PERFORM PRMT-VS
00474                  MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00475              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00476          DO-TICK-EXIT.
00477              EXIT.
00478          DO-ENDS.
00479         * MVS-GS FINAL SCREEN (SCALED ONLY): THE LAST BOARD WITH THE END
00480         * BANNER ON THE MESSAGE ROW, ALWAYS A FULL SCREEN. NOT SCALED (OR
00481         * NOT FITTING): NOTHING (DS-LEN 0), AS BEFORE MVS-GS.
00482              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00483              IF SC-ON = 0
00484                  GO TO DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00485              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00486              PERFORM SET-FACE.
00487              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00488              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00489              MOVE 1 TO BAN-ON.
00490              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00491              MOVE 0 TO BAN-ON.
00492              IF DS-OVF = 1
00493                  PERFORM SCALE-OFF.
00494              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00495          DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00496              EXIT.
00497          INIT-SCALE.
00498         * MVS-GS: SCALING AS RESOLVED BY PACPLAT (4, 3, T; ANYTHING ELSE
00499         * IS OFF). THE G1-G4 LAYOUT IS KEPT FOR A LATER FALLBACK.
00500              MOVE 1 TO SC-INIT.
00501              MOVE SPR-4 TO SPR-4-T.
00502              MOVE SPR-3 TO SPR-3-T.
00503              MOVE LAY-STATUS-ROW TO SV-STATUS-ROW.
00504              MOVE LAY-GHOSTS-ROW TO SV-GHOSTS-ROW.
00505              MOVE LAY-GHOSTS-COL TO SV-GHOSTS-COL.
00506              MOVE LAY-MSG-ROW TO SV-MSG-ROW.
00507              MOVE LAY-CMD-ROW TO SV-CMD-ROW.
00508              MOVE LAY-HELP-ROW TO SV-HELP-ROW.
00509              MOVE LAY-HELP-COL TO SV-HELP-COL.
00510              MOVE LAY-SF-ROW TO SV-SF-ROW.  10


00511              MOVE WS-HELP-TXT TO WS-HELP-G.
00512              IF REQ-SCALE = '4' OR REQ-SCALE = '3' OR REQ-SCALE = 'T'
00513                  PERFORM SCALE-ON.
00514              IF SC-ON = 0
00515                  MOVE 'N' TO REQ-SCALE.
00516              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00517          SCALE-ON.
00518              MOVE 1 TO SC-ON.
00519              MOVE 4 TO SC-W.
00520              MOVE LS-BOARD-COL-4 TO SC-BCOL.
00521              IF REQ-SCALE = '3'
00522                  MOVE 3 TO SC-W
00523                  MOVE LS-BOARD-COL-3 TO SC-BCOL.
00524              IF REQ-SCALE = 'T'
00525                  MOVE 1000 TO DS-LIMIT.
00526              MOVE LS-BOARD-ROW TO SC-BROW.
00527              MOVE LS-STATUS-ROW TO LAY-STATUS-ROW.
00528              MOVE LS-GHOSTS-ROW TO LAY-GHOSTS-ROW.
00529              MOVE LS-GHOSTS-COL TO LAY-GHOSTS-COL.
00530              MOVE LS-MSG-ROW TO LAY-MSG-ROW.
00531              MOVE LS-CMD-ROW TO LAY-CMD-ROW.
00532              MOVE LS-HELP-ROW TO LAY-HELP-ROW.
00533              MOVE LS-HELP-COL TO LAY-HELP-COL.
00534              MOVE LS-SF-ROW TO LAY-SF-ROW.
00535              MOVE WS-HELP-S TO WS-HELP-TXT.
00536          SCALE-OFF.
00537         * BACK TO THE G4 RENDERER: LAYOUT, HELP TEXT, LIMIT; THE TERMINAL
00538         * IMAGE IS UNKNOWN NOW, SO THE NEXT SCREEN IS A FULL ONE.
00539              MOVE 0 TO SC-ON.
00540              MOVE 'N' TO REQ-SCALE.
00541              MOVE 2048 TO DS-LIMIT.
00542              MOVE SV-STATUS-ROW TO LAY-STATUS-ROW.
00543              MOVE SV-GHOSTS-ROW TO LAY-GHOSTS-ROW.
00544              MOVE SV-GHOSTS-COL TO LAY-GHOSTS-COL.
00545              MOVE SV-MSG-ROW TO LAY-MSG-ROW.
00546              MOVE SV-CMD-ROW TO LAY-CMD-ROW.
00547              MOVE SV-HELP-ROW TO LAY-HELP-ROW.
00548              MOVE SV-HELP-COL TO LAY-HELP-COL.
00549              MOVE SV-SF-ROW TO LAY-SF-ROW.
00550              MOVE WS-HELP-G TO WS-HELP-TXT.
00551              MOVE 0 TO PREV-OK.
00552              MOVE 0 TO DS-OVF.
00553              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00554              MOVE 'F' TO DS-KIND.
00555          INIT-HI.
00556              MOVE 0 TO WS-HP WS-HG WS-HE WS-HN WS-HW.
00557              IF REQ-HILITE = 'Y'
00558                  MOVE HI-WALL TO WS-HW
00559                  MOVE HI-PLAYER TO WS-HP
00560                  MOVE HI-GHOST TO WS-HG
00561                  MOVE HI-ERROR TO WS-HE
00562                  MOVE HI-INPUT TO WS-HN.
00563              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00564          TOGGLE-VIS.
00565              IF VIS = 1
00566                  MOVE 0 TO VIS
00567              ELSE  11


00568                  MOVE 1 TO VIS.
00569              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00570          SET-GLYPHS.
00571              MOVE 'P' TO WS-GP.
00572              MOVE 'G' TO WS-GG.
00573              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND VIS = 0
00574                  MOVE GLY-PLAYER-1 TO WS-GP
00575                  MOVE GLY-GHOST-1 TO WS-GG.
00576              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND VIS = 1
00577                  MOVE GLY-PLAYER-2 TO WS-GP
00578                  MOVE GLY-GHOST-2 TO WS-GG.
00579              IF REQ-GLYPHS = 'G'
00580                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS-G.
00581              IF SC-ON = 1
00582                  PERFORM SET-SPRITES.
00583              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00584          SET-SPRITES.
00585         * MVS-GS SPRITE NUMBERS (PACPAL SPR-4 / SPR-3): PAC-MAN 1 RIGHT,
00586         * 2 LEFT, 3 SHUT; GHOST 4 FRAME A, 5 FRAME B (SECOND FRAME = THE
00587         * G3/G4 SECOND ANIMATION FRAME).

00594                  MOVE 5 TO SPR-GH.

00596          SET-GLYPHS-G.

00598         * ANIMATION FRAME) CLOSED MOUTH / GHOST WITH THE EYE.
00599              MOVE X-GPR TO WS-GP.
00600              IF WS-FACE = 'L'

00602              MOVE X-GG1 TO WS-GG.

00604                  MOVE X-GPC TO WS-GP
00605                  MOVE X-GG2 TO WS-GG.
00606              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00607          SET-FACE.
00608         * PAC-MAN FACES THE LAST HORIZONTAL MOVE THAT WAS NOT BLOCKED;
00609         * VERTICAL MOVES, BUMPS AND INVALID INPUT KEEP THE FACING.
00610              IF (LAST-CMD = 'L' OR LAST-CMD = 'l')
00611                                AND LAST-RESULT NOT = 'BLOCKED'

00614                                AND LAST-RESULT NOT = 'BLOCKED'
00615                  MOVE 'R' TO WS-FACE.

00673          FLIP-CELL.
00674         * SPRITE CELLS ARE FOUND BY GLYPH; GE CELLS (MVS-G4) BY THE GE

00677                  + LAY-BOARD-COL + WS-COL - 1.

00001         * PACQRYT : MVS-G4 BATCH TEST DRIVER FOR PACQRY (NOT PART OF THE
00002         * GAME). SYSIN CARDS: COLUMNS 1-8 CASE NAME, 10-73 REPLY BYTES IN
00003         * HEX (UP TO 32 PER CARD); CONSECUTIVE CARDS WITH THE SAME NAME
00004         * ARE ONE REPLY. FOR EVERY REPLY ONE LINE IS PRINTED:
00005         *   QRY NAME     LEN=NNNN C=N H=N GE=N  (COLOUR, HILITE, GE).
00006          IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
00007          PROGRAM-ID. PACQRYT.
00008          ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
00009          CONFIGURATION SECTION.
00010          SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00011          OBJECT-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00012          INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
00013          FILE-CONTROL.
00014              SELECT CARD-FILE ASSIGN TO UT-S-SYSIN.
00015          DATA DIVISION.
00016          FILE SECTION.
00017          FD  CARD-FILE
00018              RECORDING MODE IS F
00019              LABEL RECORDS ARE OMITTED
00020              RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS
00021              DATA RECORD IS CARD-REC.
00022          01  CARD-REC              PIC X(80).
00023          WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
00024          01  WS-CARD.
00025              05  CD-NAME           PIC X(8).
00026              05  FILLER            PIC X.
00027              05  CD-HEX            PIC X OCCURS 64 TIMES.
00028              05  FILLER            PIC X(7).
00029          01  Q-AREA.
00030              05  Q-CH              PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00031          01  Q-LEN                 PIC S9(4) COMP.
00032          01  Q-OUT.
00033              05  QO-COLOUR         PIC 9.
00034              05  QO-HILITE         PIC 9.
00035              05  QO-GE             PIC 9.
00036          01  CUR-NAME              PIC X(8) VALUE SPACES.
00037          01  WS-EOF                PIC 9 VALUE 0.
00038          01  WS-K                  PIC 99.
00039          01  WS-HV                 PIC 99.
00040          01  WS-LV                 PIC 99.
00041          01  WS-D                  PIC 99.
00042          01  WS-C                  PIC X.
00043          01  WS-NOP                PIC 9.
00044          01  BW.
00045              05  BW-N              PIC 9(4) COMP.
00046          01  BW-X REDEFINES BW.
00047              05  FILLER            PIC X.
00048              05  BW-L              PIC X.
00049          01  HEX-DATA              PIC X(16) VALUE '0123456789ABCDEF'.
00050          01  HEX-TABLE REDEFINES HEX-DATA.
00051              05  HEXDIG            PIC X OCCURS 16 TIMES.
00052          01  RES-LINE.
00053              05  FILLER            PIC X(4) VALUE 'QRY '.
00054              05  RL-NAME           PIC X(8).   2


00055              05  FILLER            PIC X(5) VALUE ' LEN='.
00056              05  RL-LEN            PIC 9(4).
00057              05  FILLER            PIC X(3) VALUE ' C='.
00058              05  RL-C              PIC 9.
00059              05  FILLER            PIC X(3) VALUE ' H='.
00060              05  RL-H              PIC 9.
00061              05  FILLER            PIC X(4) VALUE ' GE='.
00062              05  RL-GE             PIC 9.
00063          PROCEDURE DIVISION.
00064          MAIN-PARA.
00065              OPEN INPUT CARD-FILE.
00066              MOVE 0 TO Q-LEN.
00067              PERFORM READ-CARD THRU READ-CARD-EXIT UNTIL WS-EOF = 1.
00068              IF CUR-NAME NOT = SPACES
00069                  PERFORM EVAL-REPLY.
00070              CLOSE CARD-FILE.
00071              DISPLAY 'QRY TEST END'.
00072              STOP RUN.
00073          READ-CARD.
00074              READ CARD-FILE INTO WS-CARD
00075                  AT END MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
00076                  GO TO READ-CARD-EXIT.
00077              IF CD-NAME NOT = CUR-NAME AND CUR-NAME NOT = SPACES
00078                  PERFORM EVAL-REPLY.
00079              IF CD-NAME NOT = CUR-NAME
00080                  MOVE CD-NAME TO CUR-NAME
00081                  MOVE 0 TO Q-LEN
00082                  MOVE SPACES TO Q-AREA.
00083              MOVE 1 TO WS-K.
00084              PERFORM ADD-BYTE UNTIL WS-K > 63.
00085          READ-CARD-EXIT.
00086              EXIT.
00087          ADD-BYTE.
00088              MOVE CD-HEX (WS-K) TO WS-C.
00089              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00090              IF WS-C NOT = SPACE
00091                  PERFORM HEX-PAIR.
00092              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00093          HEX-PAIR.
00094              PERFORM DIGIT-VAL.
00095              MOVE WS-D TO WS-HV.
00096              MOVE CD-HEX (WS-K) TO WS-C.
00097              PERFORM DIGIT-VAL.
00098              MOVE WS-D TO WS-LV.
00099              COMPUTE BW-N = WS-HV * 16 + WS-LV.
00100              ADD 1 TO Q-LEN.
00101              MOVE BW-L TO Q-CH (Q-LEN).
00102          DIGIT-VAL.
00103              MOVE 1 TO WS-D.
00104              PERFORM NEXT-DIGIT UNTIL WS-D > 16
00105                  OR HEXDIG (WS-D) = WS-C.
00106              SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-D.
00107          NEXT-DIGIT.
00108              ADD 1 TO WS-D.
00109          EVAL-REPLY.
00110              CALL 'PACQRY' USING Q-AREA Q-LEN Q-OUT.
00111              MOVE CUR-NAME TO RL-NAME.   3


00112              MOVE Q-LEN TO RL-LEN.
00113              MOVE QO-COLOUR TO RL-C.
00114              MOVE QO-HILITE TO RL-H.
00115              MOVE QO-GE TO RL-GE.
00116              DISPLAY RES-LINE.   4

00001         * PACQRY : MVS-G4 CAPABILITY PARSING (PURE: NO I/O, NO TERMINAL).
00002         * CALL 'PACQRY' USING QRY-AREA QRY-LEN QRY-OUT. THE AREA HOLDS A
00003         * READ PARTITION QUERY REPLY AS RECEIVED BY PACPLAT (AID X'88'
00004         * + STRUCTURED FIELDS: LENGTH(2), X'81', QCODE, DATA). OUT:
00005         *   QO-COLOUR 1 = QCODE X'86' (MVS-G1), QO-HILITE 1 = QCODE X'87'
00006         *   (MVS-G2), QO-GE 1 = QCODE X'85' WITH FLAG X'80' (GE) AND X'02'
00007         *   (CGCSGID PRESENT) AND A SET WHOSE CODE PAGE IS 310 (APL).
00008         * THE G1/G2 DECISIONS WERE MOVED HERE FROM PACPLAT UNCHANGED.
00009          IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
00010          PROGRAM-ID. PACQRY.
00011          ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
00012          CONFIGURATION SECTION.
00013          SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00014          OBJECT-COMPUTER. IBM-370.
00015          DATA DIVISION.
00016          WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
00017          01  HEXW.
00018              05  HX-Z              PIC X VALUE LOW-VALUE.
00019              05  HX-B              PIC X.
00020          01  HEXN REDEFINES HEXW   PIC 9(4) COMP.
00021          01  WS-K                  PIC 9(4).
00022          01  WS-P                  PIC 9(4).
00023          01  WS-V                  PIC 9(4).
00024          01  WS-L                  PIC 9(4).
00025          01  WS-ID                 PIC 9(4).
00026          01  WS-QC                 PIC 9(4).
00027          01  WS-LIM                PIC 9(4).
00028          01  WS-END                PIC 9(4).
00029          01  WS-D                  PIC 9(4).
00030          01  WS-DL                 PIC 9(4).
00031          01  WS-F1                 PIC 9(4).
00032          01  WS-Q                  PIC 9(4).
00033          01  WS-R                  PIC 9(4).
00034          01  WS-CP                 PIC 9(4).
00035          01  WS-STOP               PIC 9.
00036          01  WS-DSTOP              PIC 9.
00037          01  WS-NOP                PIC 9.
00038          LINKAGE SECTION.
00039          01  QRY-AREA.
00040              05  QRY-CH            PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00041          01  QRY-LEN               PIC S9(4) COMP.
00042          01  QRY-OUT.
00043              05  QO-COLOUR         PIC 9.
00044              05  QO-HILITE         PIC 9.
00045              05  QO-GE             PIC 9.
00046          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING QRY-AREA QRY-LEN QRY-OUT.
00047          MAIN-PARA.
00048              MOVE 0 TO QO-COLOUR.
00049              MOVE 0 TO QO-HILITE.
00050              MOVE 0 TO QO-GE.
00051              PERFORM FIND-CAPS THRU FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00052              GOBACK.
00053          FIND-CAPS.
00054         * QUERY REPLY = AID X'88' (136) + STRUCTURED FIELDS: LENGTH(2),   2


00055         * X'81' (129), QCODE. COLOUR SUPPORT = QCODE X'86' (134).
00056              IF QRY-LEN < 1
00057                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00058              MOVE 1 TO WS-K.
00059              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00060              IF WS-V NOT = 136
00061                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00062              MOVE 2 TO WS-P.
00063              MOVE 0 TO WS-STOP.
00064              PERFORM NEXT-SF THRU NEXT-SF-EXIT UNTIL WS-STOP = 1.
00065          FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00066              EXIT.
00067          NEXT-SF.
00068              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-P + 3.
00069              IF WS-LIM > QRY-LEN
00070                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00071                  GO TO NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00072              MOVE WS-P TO WS-K.
00073              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00074              COMPUTE WS-L = WS-V * 256.
00075              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00076              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00077              ADD WS-V TO WS-L.
00078              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00079              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00080              MOVE WS-V TO WS-ID.
00081              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00082              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00083              MOVE WS-V TO WS-QC.
00084              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 134
00085                  MOVE 1 TO QO-COLOUR.
00086              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 135
00087                  MOVE 1 TO QO-HILITE.
00088              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 133 AND WS-L > 13
00089                  PERFORM CHAR-SETS THRU CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00090              IF WS-L < 4
00091                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00092              ELSE
00093                  ADD WS-L TO WS-P.
00094          NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00095              EXIT.
00096          CHAR-SETS.
00097         * X'85': FLAGS1 AT +4, DESCRIPTOR LENGTH (DL) AT +12, DESCRIPTORS
00098         * FROM +13 TO THE END OF THE FIELD; THE CGCSGID IS THE LAST FOUR
00099         * BYTES OF A DESCRIPTOR, ITS LAST TWO = CODE PAGE (310 = X'0136').
00100              COMPUTE WS-END = WS-P + WS-L - 1.
00101              IF WS-END > QRY-LEN
00102                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00103              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 4.
00104              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00105              MOVE WS-V TO WS-F1.
00106              IF WS-F1 < 128
00107                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00108              DIVIDE WS-F1 BY 4 GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-R.
00109              IF WS-R < 2
00110                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00111              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 12.   3


00112              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00113              MOVE WS-V TO WS-DL.
00114              IF WS-DL < 4
00115                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00116              COMPUTE WS-D = WS-P + 13.
00117              MOVE 0 TO WS-DSTOP.
00118              PERFORM NEXT-DESC UNTIL WS-DSTOP = 1.
00119          CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00120              EXIT.
00121          NEXT-DESC.
00122              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-D + WS-DL - 1.
00123              IF WS-LIM > WS-END
00124                  MOVE 1 TO WS-DSTOP.
00125              IF WS-DSTOP = 0
00126                  PERFORM DESC-CP.
00127              ADD WS-DL TO WS-D.
00128          DESC-CP.
00129              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-LIM - 1.
00130              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00131              COMPUTE WS-CP = WS-V * 256.
00132              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00133              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00134              ADD WS-V TO WS-CP.
00135              IF WS-CP = 310
00136                  MOVE 1 TO QO-GE.
00137              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00138          BYTE-VAL.
00139              MOVE QRY-CH (WS-K) TO HX-B.
00140              MOVE HEXN TO WS-V.   4
